Massive menu viewed online
Feb 2020 • Friends
Comfortable, airy restaurant with very friendly, attentive staff. The menu is viewed either on one of their iPads or you join the WiFi and view it on your phone. There’s so much to choose from you need a good 15 minutes to peruse the whole menu. Dishes were quite substantial and we took away doggy bags full of leftovers. Food all tasted very flavoursome but both the chicken and the pork ribs had a texture like the animals had died of old age, tough as old boots, but still quite juicy so not overcooked. Warm beer served with giant ice cubes. All very reasonably priced. Enjoyable lunch.
